entities.summary: Mswati III, a notable figure in the history of Eswatini, associated with Pro-Democracy Movement and Protests (2018–2018). Preceded by Swaziland Renamed Eswatini 2018. Their legacy influenced Eswatini Protests 2021 and 2021 Pro-Democracy Uprising.
